messages:
alex: Quick sync — finalizing release notes for midnight push (Wed 11pm PT). I pushed a draft to the RN doc, need signoff on the 'behavior changes' paragraph. TL;DR: canary 10% for 30m, rollback criteria = error rate >1.5% or latency +50ms p95. /cc @jess @lucy
jess: looking. can you paste the exact blurb we plan to publish? don't want surprises for CS.
alex: paste blurb:
```
Release v1.4.3 — Improved routing and caching: reduced median token latency by ~15% for LLM workloads. Note: cached KV semantics changed for prefix-matching; existing long-running sessions may see a brief mismatch — we recommend session refresh on reconnect.
```
sam: Suggest changing 'may see a brief mismatch' -> 'may see transient context desync, please refresh sessions'. clearer for customers.
lucy: +1 to sam wording. Also add note about Dedicated customers: 'no-inplace-migration; contact success for migration playbook'.
ryan: Ops ask: confirm canary lanes: deploybot will spin up canary pool in us-west-2. plan: 10% traffic 30m -> 50% 60m -> full. rollback: manual or auto if errors spike. Is that set in deploybot?
ops-bot: deploybot: created run 5172023460 for release v1.4.3-canary. Command queued: `/deploy run 5172023460 --policy canary --steps 10%,50%,100% --step-durations 30m,60m` :white_check_mark:
jess: can we include a short ops line in RN: 'If rollout triggers automatic rollback, we'll post in #incidents and ops will notify leads.'
alex: good. also pin the RN and a one-liner for the org channel — short ops note + link. Draft for org channel:
```
Heads-up: rolling update tonight 11pm PT for the inference routing runtime. Expect brief canary validation; impact unlikely. Ops/CS on standby.
```
lucy: nit: change 'impact unlikely' -> 'no user-visible changes expected; ops watching'.
sam: final signoff from me on copy. jess? 
jess: approve. alex please update RN doc and pin. I'll prep support snippet for CS.
alex: done — RN pinned in #eng-releases and org blurb queued. deploybot queued run starts at 2026-03-21T06:00:00Z (11pm PT). Thanks team :tada:
ops-bot: deploybot: run 5172023460 started — canary step 10% (us-west-2). Monitoring channels: #eng-monitor #incidents :rocket:
ryan: leaving stand-by 11-12:30pm PT, paging enabled. If rollback, follow rollback checklist in playbook (link)
alex: copy that — I'll post the final one-liner in #general at T-minus 30m.
